result.title: Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning
result.comment: Equal contribution by Li Yuan and Yaxin Hou. Corresponding author: Yuheng Jia. Emails: {yuan-li,yaxin,230259148,yhjia}@seu.edu.cn, gaoyb@qlu.edu.cn. 18 pages
result.summary: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向标签与类别分布双重不匹配的半监督学习，提出 hub-spoke 潜空间几何：已知类围绕中心 hub 均匀分布并形成紧凑类簇，hub 作为高不确定性未知类样本的低证据锚点，并配合基于证据的分类器提升特征判别力与不确定性分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属半监督视觉分类而非 VLM 推理，但其「结构化潜空间几何 + 证据式不确定性分离」可能为 LVR 的表示组织、视觉证据筛选与 STOP 决策（不确定性判据）提供可核查的线索。
